instructions: Zenit Week is a weekly planner shown as a mind map: branches (categories) hold tasks, tasks may hold sub-tasks. All writes act on the week open in the app, exactly as if the user clicked; each call is one undo step and shows the user a toast. Read zenit://week/current (or call get_stats) first to learn branch and task ids. Use open_week to switch weeks before writing to another week. Days are ISO weekdays: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday. A label ending in "Nx" (e.g. "Pushups 10x") makes N ticks recorded with tick_task; days and Nx do not combine. Never put relative days (today, tomorrow) in labels: pass days instead. The first request may answer that Zenit Week is not connected yet and give a code: tell the user that code, ask them to check it matches the one shown in Zenit Week and click Allow there, and call again only after they confirm. Every result names the app that ran it in "app": "Zenit Week" for the production site, a host name such as abc.ngrok-free.app for a development copy. When zenit://apps lists more than one app, pass "app" on every call and say which app you changed.
